title: Accessible interaction types from the start
statement: Every interaction a student uses must work by keyboard and assistive technology and be legible, checked from the start, because an item a learner can't operate yields an invalid score.
example: In one reading course, 406 of 1,005 items (40%) could not be operated by keyboard or assistive technology.
detail: A round-1 red team of a grade 4 reading course counted 406 of 1,005 items (40%) that could not be operated by keyboard or assistive technology (`grade3-reading/ti-courseplans/docs/redteam-sources/g4-reading-redteam-round1-2026-07-07.md`). In a grade 5 course the anti-leak design deliberately concentrated items in hot-text, sequence and match formats (525 of 772), precisely the accessibility-risk types (`grade3-reading/ti-courseplans/docs/redteam-sources/g5-reading-redteam-round1-2026-07-06.md`). A review of the grade 3 course found its drag-and-drop and matching items unusable this way and added that an item type that cannot be made accessible is also not a faithful rehearsal of the test. The item generator's rubric now builds accessibility in from the start, because the team's own evaluation had never checked it (`grade3-reading/ti-courseplans/docs/course-formula-agents.md`). This covers drag-to-order, text selection and audio controls. No anti-guessing control may block an accessible path or let a screen reader give part of the answer away, as when 192 of 198 match items announced an unused decoy category to screen readers (`grade3-reading/artifacts/g5_build_2026_07_02/package/G5_EXECUTED_ACTIONS_CHECKLIST.md`, line 39; `ti-courseplans-audit/docs/standards/student-course-quality/versions/1.0.0/STANDARD.qmd`, line 535).
against: The grade 4 count was disclosed as platform-dependent: whether an item can be operated also depends on the platform that serves it (`grade3-reading/ti-courseplans/docs/redteam-sources/g4-reading-redteam-round1-2026-07-07.md`). The same checklist says a clean static scan does not imply a WCAG 2.1 AA pass, and the dynamic half of the audit was not done. the 406/1,005 figure is marked platform-dependent (`ti-courseplans-audit/docs/redteam-sources/g4-reading-redteam-round1-2026-07-07.md`). The real test uses the same formats for Grade 3, so the fix is to build them accessibly, as the test does, rather than drop them: "MAP uses these for G3 — check MAP's implementation" (`grade3-reading/knowledge_bot/knowledge/kb-0076-coe-catchup-2026-06-30.qmd`, line 21).
